candidates.name: search_retrieval_system_prompt
candidates.hypothesis: Introducing a structured search-and-retrieval system prompt that directs the model to use concise keyword queries (avoiding long verbatim quotes), actively call get_document on promising search results rather than relying solely on snippets, and avoid repeating failing queries will eliminate snippet-blindness and search-looping, raising the validation pass rate from 36.7% to over 50% while reducing average turns and token usage.
candidates.changes: Add system_prompt.txt providing general guidelines on effective keyword querying, inspecting full documents via get_document, and avoiding duplicate queries
candidates.expected_efficiency: Average turns decrease from 21.3 to <18.0 and mean input tokens decrease by ~15-25% due to fewer 25-turn exhausted search loops
